blocks.en: Render each `.mmd` file that you show with the npm package `pele@1.9.0`, and give the user the SVG. Install Pele once, outside the repo. Write each SVG next to its `.mmd` file, with the same name. The API is at https://pele.run/api. Pass `{ limit: 1_000_000, outputLimit: 8_000_000, maxEdges: 10_000 }` as the options of `render`. Pele's defaults are smaller than a chart of 500 states can be. When Pele throws a `PeleError`, show the user the Mermaid text and the error.
blocks.zh: 对展示的每个 `.mmd` 文件，用 npm 包 `pele@1.9.0` 渲染并提供 SVG。在仓库外安装 Pele 一次。SVG 与 `.mmd` 放同目录、同名。API 见 https://pele.run/api。向 `render` 传入 `{ limit: 1_000_000, outputLimit: 8_000_000, maxEdges: 10_000 }`，因为 Pele 默认限制可能不足以容纳 500 状态的图。抛出 `PeleError` 时，向用户展示 Mermaid 文本与错误。

blocks.en: Pele ignores Mermaid `theme` and `themeVariables`. Set its `--pele-*` CSS variables on `.pele`. https://pele.run/theming lists them. The command gives each state the color class of its group, such as `class sN teal`. It marks each bad state with `class sN breaks` or `class sN mayBreak`, each state on the shortest path to a bug with `class sN bugPath`, and each state that a PROPERTY counterexample repeats forever with `class sN repeats`. Pele puts these classes on the state's node. Color the classes with CSS.
blocks.zh: Pele 忽略 Mermaid 的 `theme` 和 `themeVariables`，需在 `.pele` 设置 `--pele-*` CSS 变量，列表见 https://pele.run/theming。命令为状态指定组颜色类，如 `class sN teal`；错误状态标 `class sN breaks` 或 `class sN mayBreak`，最短缺陷路径上的状态标 `class sN bugPath`，PROPERTY 反例中无限重复的状态标 `class sN repeats`。Pele 将类放在状态节点上，用 CSS 着色。

blocks.en: The `.mmd` file has a `classDef` line for `breaks` and for `mayBreak`, so that any Mermaid viewer shows the bug marks. It has no `classDef` for the group colors, `bugPath`, or `repeats`. Pele writes each `classDef` color as a `style` attribute on the node, and a `style` attribute wins over a normal CSS rule. So the rules for the marks below use `!important`. Without it, a dark theme keeps the light mark colors. A bug mark sets the fill and the text, and `bugPath` and `repeats` set the border. Put the mark rules after the group colors, so that a mark shows over the group color.
blocks.zh: `.mmd` 包含 `breaks` 和 `mayBreak` 的 `classDef`，让所有 Mermaid 查看器都能显示缺陷标记。组颜色、`bugPath`、`repeats` 则没有 `classDef`。Pele 将 `classDef` 颜色写入节点的 `style` 属性，其优先级高于普通 CSS，因此下方标记规则使用 `!important`，否则暗色主题仍会保持亮色标记。缺陷标记设置填充和文字，`bugPath` 与 `repeats` 设置边框。标记规则放在组颜色之后，确保覆盖组颜色。

blocks.en: These colors are suggestions. They are the colors of the old skill. Put them in a `<style>` element at the start of each SVG. Each SVG then follows the light or dark setting of the viewer.
blocks.zh: 下方颜色只是建议，沿用旧版技能。将它们放在每个 SVG 开头的 `<style>` 元素中，SVG 就能跟随查看器的亮色或暗色设置。
